resources.string: The fun-loving Koda is a happy and energetic Golden Retriever. He loves to go on hikes, swim in the lake, and play catch with his favorite people.
The old soul Lola is a serious but loving Poodle. She likes to spend time with her grandparent, to read, and to make tea.
The beloved Frankie is a beloved Golden Retriever. He loves to go on walks with his mom, to nap, and to eat his favorite kibble.
The brave Nox is a fearless and loving Dachshund. He loves to play with other dogs, bark at squirrels, and sleep in the sun.
The curious Faye is a curious and playful Corgi. She loves to explore, to play with her toys, and to curl up and take a nap.
The sweet Bella is a gentle and loving Labrador Retriever. She loves to go on walks, to swim in the pool, and to cuddle with her owners.
The outgoing Moana is an outgoing and friendly Husky. She loves to play, to run in the park, and to howl at the moon.
The spirited Tzeitel is a spirited and playful Shih Tzu. She loves to play with her toys, to go on walks, and to eat her favorite treats.
The lovable Leroy is a lovable and fun-loving Beagle. He loves to sniff around the yard, to play fetch, and to eat his favorite snacks.
